limitations: One shared workstation; a foreign GPU compute process remained resident. Presence does not establish activity or inactivity.
Three repetitions per workload per session. No p95, general agent-quality or bitwise-equivalence claim.
Backend/API synthetic workloads; no actual Hermes or Privy caller attribution.
Small decode differences overlap reference variation; only repeated sibling-resume latency supports promotion.
Prefix borrowing needs an explicitly enabled bounded RAM conversation cache; it does not provide unlimited 128K conversation sharing.
Sampled process-tree RSS and whole-card peaks; GPU peak columns are MiB, utilization %, W, degrees C. No CPU energy or thermal-throttling measurements.

decode.replay_policy: One warmup, then fixed topic order repeated; adaptive expert state is not reset between requests.
